item.name: Mask of Madness

effects.title: Berserk
effects.text: Gives 100 attack speed, 6% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 15%/30% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you.  Lasts 6 seconds.

effects.title: Lifesteal
effects.text: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

item.lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.
